Resend: the receiver supports conditional writes and dry runs, so a write conditional on v2 would apply. But it would move the location backwards to WARD-B, which the patient has left. The only gap is that the 08:20 WARD-B stay is missing from the history. Filling it would need a correct_history policy (E1 alternative), which is outside Shutter's write scope. Only the receiver's record and receipts can be checked afterwards. Effects on the bed board, pharmacy, porters and EPR are inferred (DEP-1.1). Recommend no resend.
